root_cause.finding: The hypothesis to verify first (1000-token structured output cap, as in #7908) is not the cause. The BFF sent SemanticReconstructionDraft.model_json_schema() with the StrategySpec under $defs; that schema declares $defs at the root and $ref at strategy_map, next_best_question and strategy_spec/anyOf[0]. The adapter's structured validator (assistant_openclaw_provider._SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS) refuses $defs/$ref, and it validates only after the model answers, so every paid reconstruction answer, of any size, became 422 OPENCLAW_TOOL_ARGS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH ('root' declares unsupported schema keyword(s) ['$defs']). The BFF then mapped every non-503/504 adapter status to 502 structured_provider and dropped the error_code.
root_cause.reproduction: offline, real adapter validator, no stub: unsupported_schema_keyword_paths(raw schema) = ['root: $defs', 'strategy_map: $ref', 'next_best_question: $ref', 'strategy_spec/anyOf[0]: $ref']; _validate_extraction_arguments(any draft, raw schema) -> OpenClawProviderError 422 OPENCLAW_TOOL_ARGS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH. fix.queue_only_admission: POST /messages calls admit_reconstruction_job (event reads + one conditional card write, no provider call, no private-content read) and runs run_reconstruction_job as a FastAPI background task after the response. Admission errors never fail message acceptance
fix.job_record: the existing per-workshop reconstruction card (strategy_workshop_card, one row per workshop, existing retention) is the job record: payload.job_id owns it and every transition (queued -> running -> completed|failed) is compare_and_set_workshop_card (Postgres: INSERT .. ON CONFLICT (card_id) DO UPDATE .. WHERE payload_json->>'job_id' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM expected RETURNING). The command-receipt store was not used because admit_command advances the workshop lock and would break the client's next If-Match. A job keys on the last message sequence_no, so persona/other events do not start a second job; a job superseded by a newer message never overwrites the newer card; a queued/running job older than PANTHEON_WORKSHOP_RECONSTRUCTION_JOB_LEASE_SECONDS (default 180) is taken over
fix.reconstruct_route: POST /reconstruct replays a completed job (job_status replayed), waits on a queued/running job by reading the card for PANTHEON_WORKSHOP_RECONSTRUCTION_WAIT_SECONDS (default 90, no provider call; 202 with job_status if still in flight), replays a deterministic failure as its typed error, and re-runs only a missing, abandoned, transiently failed (provider_timeout, provider_unavailable, private_content_unavailable) or pre-job legacy failed job. The current frontend (reconstructWorkshopStrategy awaits data.reconstruction_id) keeps working unchanged
fix.typed_reason: ReconstructionProviderError.reason in {provider_output_schema_mismatch, provider_output_invalid_json, extraction_schema_unsupported, provider_policy_denied, provider_timeout, provider_unavailable, draft_validation_failed, conversation_too_large, private_content_unavailable, provider_error} plus adapter_error_code (identifier-shaped only). Failed card: summary 'Reconstruction failed: <reason>', payload failure_reason / failure_status / adapter_error_code. API: error.details.reason = <reason>, error.details.adapter_error_code. No upstream message text is stored or returned

候選訊號要求分點淨買超占比、合格分點連買及放量突破三項條件同時成立；三大法人買賣超被列為資料需求，但沒有明訂為訊號門檻。
訊號確認後於次一交易日集合競價結束後分批限價買入；另訂停損、移動停利、分點轉賣超出場及25個交易日的最長持有期限。
操作者明訂投組權重與現金限制，以及兩項大盤條件同時成立時的新部位減半規則。
驗證採近兩年滾動樣本外回測，扣除來回交易稅與手續費。
